title: BAI Hosts Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is organized by BAI in India to enhance the skills of Indian badminton coaches.
summary: The Badminton Association of India is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, running from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a major domestic team championship, crucial for Indian state teams and players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This directly impacts the composition of the Indian junior team for a prestigious international event.
summary: A notification has been released regarding a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's young talent for upcoming continental junior championships.
summary: The Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Final Selection Trials for World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: This outlines the crucial final steps for Indian players to qualify for the World Junior Championships.
summary: The list of eligible players and those qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, has been released.
